text:
maria.dev: quick heads up — while running the onboarding sampleapp with the JS SDK we hit duplicate pages when a token refresh and a 429 happened in the same flow. repro below.

sam.k: can you paste a minimal log/snippet?

maria.dev: repro summary: js-sdk@1.4.2, sampleapp uses cursor paging. Sequence: fetch page (cursor=A) -> server 429 + Retry-After -> client triggers auth refresh -> refresh completes -> client retries original request but still uses cursor=A -> server accepted and returned page B -> client then continued using old cursor and got overlapping items.

maria.dev: log snippet:
```http
POST /v1/search?page_cursor=A -> 429 Retry-After: 1
[auth] refresh start
[auth] refresh ok, new token issued
retrying original request with old body (cursor=A)
server -> 200 page items ids: 1001..1010 cursor=B
client then requests with cursor=A -> got items 1005..1012 (overlap)
```

alok: that sounds like a retry + auth refresh ordering bug. last time we saw something similar the go-sdk flow updated the request headers before retrying, js-sdk retried the cloned request without re-running auth middleware.

olivia: is the retry triggered by our generic backoff or by the sampleapp? any special pagination wrapper?

maria.dev: it's the SDK's built-in fetchWithRetry invoked by the sampleapp's paging loop (no explicit app-side retry).

sam.k: ok parity note: go-sdk wraps the roundtrip so token refresh happens inline and the retried request replays with updated headers and updated body (we had a small fix for non-idempotent pagination earlier). js-sdk had an optimization where it reuses the serialized request object when retrying, which explains the stale cursor.

alok: short-term mitigation: change sampleapp to surface 429 from paginated endpoints (don't auto retry) and let the app-level pager re-fetch with fresh state. Also add a client-side guard: if a retry succeeded but next cursor changed, raise a non-fatal warning.

olivia: long-term SDK action items:
- Make auth refresh fully synchronous and ensure retries re-run auth interceptors.
- Ensure retry clones rehydrate dynamic fields (cursor, idempotency token) rather than shallow-clone.
- Add a test that simulates token refresh + 429 during paging to catch regressions.

sam.k: I'll open a PR for js-sdk to stop shallow-cloning request bodies on retry and to re-run auth middleware. I'll also add the unit test that simulates a forced token refresh mid-retry.

maria.dev: filing a DX bug and documenting the sampleapp workaround in onboarding guide. assigning @sam.k and @alok.

ci-bot: created issue #DEVEX-1429: "js-sdk: retry clones should re-run auth + avoid stale pagination cursors" and linked PR draft.

maria.dev: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
